caption: The drawing is done in black ink on a beige or off-white background and depicts a small, ornate pavilion labeled "PARK SHELTER." The structure is composed of six slim, highly detailed columns supporting an elaborately decorated hexagonal roof with intricate trim along the eaves and arches between the columns. The top of the roof has a tall, decorative finial made up of several stacked elements, ending in a stylized floral or flame-like ornament. The area beneath the structure is open, showing the ground covered in tall grass and vegetation. To the left and right of the shelter, the ground continues with more grass, and the background features clouds outlined with bold lines and shaded with parallel hatching. There are measurement marks indicating the height as 93 inches and the width as 84 inches at the base. The words "Park Shelter" are written to the right of the pavilion, and the word "Pavillion" appears in small text at the bottom right corner.
title: Cast Iron Pavilion
